guard: A refused journal append OR a held run among a race's settled arms unwinds the run ahead of the winner scan; a winning sibling may not bury a refused append as a completed race, and may not bury a held arm's heal inside a settled scope a resume short-circuits. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: a winning sibling buries the refused append and the race completes (the defect)
mutations.replace:
const refusedAppend = undefined as PromiseRejectedResult | undefined;
    if (refusedAppend !== undefined) throw (refusedAppend as PromiseRejectedResult).reason as Error;
mutations.expectRed: a refused append inside a race unwinds the run even though a sibling won
mutations.completionMarker: ok and a resume replays the same winner from the record
mutations.cell: a refused append inside a race unwinds the run even though a sibling won
mutations.note: Measured before the rule at 3aabb2583: outcome COMPLETED, race:either settled/ok, ask:q pending forever. The mutant reproduces exactly that by never finding the refused arm.

mutations.name: a held arm is buried by the winner, so the heal a resume owes never fires
mutations.find: r.status === "rejected" && (r.reason instanceof RunHeld || r.reason instanceof JournalAppendRejected),
mutations.expectRed: a held arm inside a race unwinds the run even though a sibling won
mutations.completionMarker: ok and the refused step is still pending, not recorded as anything it is not
mutations.cell: a held arm inside a race unwinds the run even though a sibling won
mutations.note: Dropping RunHeld from the hoist lets the sleeping sibling win and settle the race over the refused arm; the settled scope short-circuits on resume, so the L5016 step would stay refused forever with the run recorded completed.
